div.div:
Why externalTrafficPolicy: Local is mandatory
Default policy "Cluster" SNATs the packet to the receiving node's IP — the pod then sees
10.10.0.x, never 10.10.1.3. IP-based NetworkPolicy/AuthorizationPolicy + audit logs all break.
"Local" preserves the real client source IP end-to-end.
